lines.text: What would you do if your AI agent had a dozen helpers,
and it still felt slow and kind of confused?
Well, every handoff is like a game of telephone,
where little details get lost along the way.
Step one: build a small test set first, even ten real examples.
Step two: fold one helper back into the main agent,
turning its prompt into a skill that loads only when needed.
Step three: run your tests again, more than once,
and keep the helper only if the folded version scores worse.
One team tried this and got about two times faster.
So one brain, one memory, the right tools,
and maybe your agent never needed all those helpers.
